value.headline: **protect tenants** **increase housing supply** **preserve affordability** **revitalize neighborhoods**.
value.subheadline: Tolemi is a civic technology company that builds data integration, spatial insights, and workflow automation software for state and local governments. We help you unlock the power of municipal data so your agency can ensure safe, stable housing and build stronger neighborhoods.

value.heading: From Data to Action
value.subheading: Tolemi’s software platform integrates your siloed data, connects the dots you can’t see, and delivers the insights that drive smarter decisions and more efficient workflows.

stages.label: Data
stages.detail: Ownership, sales, police & fire, code enforcement, permits, 311 complaints, utilities, business licenses, **all connected** across every department & agency.

stages.label: Insights
stages.detail: Owner timelines, linked LLC’s, suspected rentals, vacancy indicators, **derived automatically** from your data and external sources.

stages.label: Workflows
stages.detail: **End-to-end** property registrations, inspections, email and snail mail campaigns, payment collection, asset management, and compliance.

stages.label: Automation
stages.detail: Internal & external communications, renewal notifications, non-compliance flags, task tracking, performance dashboards—all **fully automated**.

value.heading: An Integrated Platform, a Modular Approach
value.subheading: We help state & local governments create, launch, and run effective programs that advance smart housing policies. For some, doing so requires our end-to-end platform. Others utilize specific Tolemi software applications to address key pain points with existing systems. We work with our partners to design the right solution for today’s challenges.

items.name: Slate
items.headline: Your agency runs on processes.
items.description: Slate replaces disconnected spreadsheets and generic case management systems with purpose-built workflows tied directly to parcels, so your team can track every property, task, and deadline in one place. Nothing falls through the cracks.

features.title: Automate Workflows
features.description: Slate connects directly to parcel-level systems of record to kick off and route workflows based on data like code violations, property sales, and constituent inquiries.

features.title: Custom Configuration
features.description: Tolemi works with your team to understand the workflows, registries, and data you need, then builds Slate to match, so it's intuitive from day one rather than adapted after the fact.

features.title: Performance Management
features.description: Delegate tasks, track workflow progress by stage, and view automated reports on your team's output.

features.title: Analyze Data
features.description: Layer data created in Slate with BuildingBlocks to see how your programs and teams are impacting your community, connecting operational work to citywide spatial analysis.

features.title: Map-Based Tracking
features.description: Every property and project is geocoded and visualized on a map, so your team sees where work is happening, not just a list of addresses in a spreadsheet.

features.title: Registration & Compliance
features.description: Run permit, licensing, and registry programs end-to-end, from online application intake and fee collection to renewal tracking, follow-up workflows, and enforcement.

useCases.title: Long-Term Rental Registration, Licensing, and Inspections
useCases.description: Launch permit or licensing programs quickly with configurable intake forms, payments, and automated renewals.

useCases.title: Short-Term Rental Identification & Registration
useCases.description: Keep STR’s compliant with best-in-class identification along with intake, renewals, fee collection, and compliance workflows in one place.

useCases.title: Asset Management
useCases.description: Streamline workflows for public sector redevelopment agencies through entire property lifecycle: acquisition, maintenance, construction, disposition, and compliance.

useCases.title: Vacant and Foreclosure Registries
useCases.description: Identify suspected vacant properties using proprietary Tolemi insights, then automate noticing, manage registrations, and maintain compliance in a single platform.

items.imageAlt: Slate rental registration workflow for a property at the inspection stage, with linked owner and task progress

items.name: BuildingBlocks
items.headline: Your data is already there.
items.description: BuildingBlocks brings every property, owner, and department dataset into one map-based interface and delivers your team the answers they need in seconds.

features.title: One-Click Property Data
features.description: A complete, up-to-date profile for every property in your municipality: ownership, condition, permits, violations, and more. Pulled automatically from any connected system.

features.title: Search & Filter Properties
features.description: Easy-to-use filters to quickly surface properties that meet specific criteria: vacant, non-compliant, investor-owned, or any combination your work requires.

features.title: Research & Link Owners
features.description: Comprehensive data on every owner in your municipality with smart linking that identifies related owners across shell LLCs and fragmented portfolios.

features.title: Build & Share Reports
features.description: Customizable reports and data visualizations, shareable as dashboards that automatically refresh when the underlying data changes.

features.title: Set Alerts
features.description: Get notified when properties hit custom-defined triggers: a change in ownership, a new violation, a permit filed. Your team stays ahead of changing conditions.

features.title: Spatial Analysis
features.description: Map-based analysis at the parcel, block, neighborhood, and citywide level, so you can see patterns and direct resources where they'll be most impactful.

useCases.title: Investor Tracking
useCases.description: See through shell LLC structures to identify who controls large rental portfolios and how they're maintaining properties.

useCases.title: Cross-Department Operations
useCases.description: Close gaps between planning, enforcement, police, and fire with a shared data layer.

useCases.title: Rental Identification
useCases.description: Surface unregistered long-term rentals and STRs and overlay against your registry to close compliance gaps.

useCases.title: Affordable Housing
useCases.description: Map publicly owned land, identify site assembly opportunities, and match underutilized parcels to funding incentives.

useCases.title: Code Enforcement
useCases.description: Flag non-compliant properties, track violation history, and route cases without manual research.

useCases.title: Housing & Blight
useCases.description: Identify vacant and distressed properties, track absentee ownership, and prioritize intervention.

items.imageAlt: BuildingBlocks map view of connected city property data

items.name: PubliCity
items.headline: Your community has questions.
items.description: Most municipalities and agencies field the same property questions from residents, developers, and buyers over and over. PubliCity broadcasts property information on a user-friendly map and kicks off workflows with digital applications.

features.title: List Properties for Sale
features.description: Allow prospective buyers to browse available properties on an interactive map, view parcel details, and submit purchase applications directly through the portal.

features.title: Present Major Projects to the Public
features.description: Publish development projects, redevelopment plans, and major city initiatives to keep your community informed. Status updates, location context, and project details, all in one place.

features.title: Customizable Search Filters
features.description: Configurable filters help buyers and community members narrow down properties by type, status, location, or any criteria relevant to your programs, so they can find what they're looking for without staff assistance.

features.title: Collect Applications & Feedback
features.description: Residents and applicants can submit purchase applications, development inquiries, or community feedback directly through PubliCity, routed straight to the right staff member in Slate.

useCases.title: Property Listing Portal
useCases.description: List city-owned and land bank properties for public purchase, with applications routed directly to staff.

useCases.title: Vacant and Foreclosure Registration
useCases.description: Identify non-compliant properties and ease the registration process to collect fees.

useCases.title: Community Feedback
useCases.description: Collect structured input from residents on properties and projects, tied directly to parcel records in your system.

useCases.title: Constituent Self-Service
useCases.description: Reduce inbound calls and emails by giving residents the answers they need without having to wait for staff.

useCases.title: Code Violation Transparency
useCases.description: Give residents access to property violation history to empower informed decisions about where to live and rent.

useCases.title: Affordable Housing Search
useCases.description: Help residents and developers find affordable housing opportunities, filtered by type, location, and eligibility.

useCases.title: Development Transparency
useCases.description: Publish major projects and keep the community informed on status, location, and development type in real time.

value.heading: Your property registry empowered by your data
value.body: Our differentiation is the data. Using constantly up-to-date records from city and county systems, Tolemi identifies every rental property, including those recently converted from owner-occupied. Your staff can prioritize outreach, identify the worst offenders, and increase registrations.

bullets.title: Owner linking
bullets.description: LLCs, trusts, and shells resolve back to the actual person or organization holding the property. No registering five buildings that pass while quietly skipping the two that don't.

bullets.title: Automate compliance
bullets.description: Long-term rentals, short-term rentals, vacant structures, foreclosures: flagging unregistered properties and compliance outreach are automated.

bullets.title: Risk-based inspections
bullets.description: The worst properties are seen the most, while well-maintained units can self-inspect most years. Inspector time goes where the data says it matters.

value.heading: Not Another Generic Software Vendor

We bring that network's experience, best practices, and pitfalls to avoid to every new program.
